messages.subject: Instruction - forensic exam of PT-DB-07 interlock (Pennington)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Dr Iqbal,

We instruct you on behalf of Pennington Industries to examine the tongue-actuated interlock switch removed from deburring machine PT-DB-07 following an incident on 14 January, and to opine on the mechanism by which it failed to prevent spindle operation with the guard open. Continuity of evidence has been preserved. Please treat your report as for the purpose of advising the client and confirm your availability and fee.

Tom Gallagher

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Instruction - forensic exam of PT-DB-07 interlock (Pennington)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

My report (WML-26-0418) is finalised and attached. In short: the switch did not achieve positive opening on withdrawal of the actuator because of cumulative wear and swarf/coolant contamination; periodic function testing would have detected it. I recommend coded non-contact switches going forward.

Faisal

messages.htmlBody:
Dear Tom,

My report (WML-26-0418) is finalised and attached. In short: the switch did not achieve positive opening on withdrawal of the actuator because of cumulative wear and swarf/coolant contamination; periodic function testing would have detected it. I recommend coded non-contact switches going forward.

Faisal
